verdict.rationale: The evidence only says Sardine's protected documentation includes API references, SDKs and sample apps. Nothing shows the API reference is interactive or offers runnable or try-it examples. A static, access-gated reference and separate sample apps are adjacent to this story, not the capability itself. The sandbox dashboard is a product environment, not a runnable API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
